title: Searching for a Controller by Trying It: A Pole on a Cart, Four Gains, and Random Changes Kept When They Help

artifact.note: learning by trial for a continuous state: the classic pole on a cart (a cart pushed by a limited force along a track, a pole hinged on it), a controller that is four gains on the cart's position and speed and the pole's angle and rate, a score that is the mean number of steps it balances from random small starts, and random search, which tries a random change to the gains and keeps it when the score is higher; the score before any learning, after ten, fifty and three hundred tries, and on starts the search never saw
